toegepas.na: Dit is 'n gewelddadige situasie wanneer iemand
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'X is wanneer' is an anglicism ('is when'); 'Dit is X wanneer' is the natural Afrikaans form and keeps every word of the definition.
toegepas.fout: 'X is wanneer' copies the English 'X is when' construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The natural Afrikaans form keeps every word of the definition, and the study block is not the shared [begrip] entry.

toegepas.voor: 'n Ander teken is wanneer jy self voel dat iets verkeerd raak
toegepas.na: Nog 'n teken is wanneer jy self voel dat iets verkeerd loop
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Nog 'n' means an additional one where ''n ander' means a different one, and the idiom is 'iets loop verkeerd', not 'raak verkeerd'.
toegepas.fout: ''n Ander teken' means a different sign where an additional one is meant, and 'iets raak verkeerd' is not the fixed expression.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nog 'n teken' and 'iets loop verkeerd' are the natural Afrikaans forms, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.blok: By die huis, by die skool en in die gemeenskap
toegepas.voor: twee grootmense stry en hulle stemme klim hoër
toegepas.na: twee grootmense stry, en hulle stemme word harder
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans voices get 'harder', not 'hoër' (which is pitch), matching the list's 'Stemme word harder'; and the AWS comma is needed before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects.
toegepas.fout: 'Stemme klim hoër' describes pitch rather than loudness, and the AWS comma is missing between two clauses that each have their own subject.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Word harder' is the Afrikaans idiom and matches the list's 'Stemme word harder'; the comma follows AWS 2017.

toegepas.voor: Sê vir 'n volwassene wat jy vertrou waar jy gaan wees
toegepas.na: Sê vir 'n volwassene wat jy vertrou, waar jy gaan wees
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closing the relative clause stops 'vertrou waar' being read together as one clause.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma 'vertrou waar' runs together and a reader stumbles at the clause boundary.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks where the relative clause ends, leaves the protected wording intact, and does not change the instruction.

toegepas.voor: Kies saam met 'n volwassene wat jy vertrou 'n tweede pad
toegepas.na: Kies saam met 'n volwassene wat jy vertrou, 'n tweede pad
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closing the relative clause makes clear where the object 'n tweede pad' begins.
toegepas.fout: 'Vertrou 'n tweede pad' reads together on a first pass, as if the road were being trusted.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma after the embedded relative clause shows where the object starts, and the protected wording stays intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Oop veld' is the usual Afrikaans expression and avoids repeating 'leë' from the same sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'Leë' is repeated within one short sentence, and 'leë veld' is less idiomatic than 'oop veld'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Oop veld' is the usual expression, and 'stil, leë plekke' already says the place is empty.

toegepas.voor: Jy bel self en die oproep
toegepas.na: Jy bel self, en die oproep
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: The AWS comma is missing before 'en' between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain AWS 2017 punctuation fix that changes no words.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Verfilm' means to make a film of a story and needs an object; recording a fight on a phone is 'dit afneem'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Verfilm' is acceptable for filming, and 'of dit afneem' can be misread as 'or it decreases', so the proposal adds a stumble.

na_skrywer.na: terug na 'n plek waar iemand pas baklei
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Gaan terug waar' lacks its destination; 'gaan terug na 'n plek waar' is the grammatical form, and the protected opening stays intact.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Gaan terug waar' leaves the destination without its preposition, which reads elliptically.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is minor but real, and this is a safety instruction with a protected opening, so the writer owns its wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Iets wat iemand vat om 'n ander mens mee seer te maak
na_skrywer.na: Iets wat iemand gebruik om 'n ander mens seer te maak
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Vat ... mee' is informal and clumsy for a definition; 'gebruik om ... seer te maak' is clear and natural.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Vat ... mee' is informal and a bit wooden for a definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so it has to go to the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: By die huis, by die skool en in die gemeenskap
vlae.teks: Geweld hoort nie by sekere mense of by sekere plekke nie.
vlae.rede: 'Hoort nie by' reads as 'violence is not proper for certain people', while the block seems to mean violence is not limited to certain people or places (and places take 'op', not 'by'); fixing it means guessing whether 'net' is intended, which adds a qualifier, so it goes to the writer.

vlae.blok: Wat is 'n gewelddadige situasie? / gewelddadige situasie
vlae.teks: of dit enige oomblik gaan doen
vlae.rede: 'Enige oomblik' is a possible anglicism ('any moment'); 'elke oomblik' is the more idiomatic form, but the same wording stands in the glossary definition, which cannot be targeted uniquely, so the two must change together or not at all.
